title: Call-back scheduling and emergency call messages
summary: This topic mainly contains procedural call-back and follow-up mentions, with a smaller set of complaints about emergency call system malfunction messages.

negative.summary: Negative reviews describe emergency call system malfunction messages appearing at startup or as an error that led the customer to seek service.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mostly mention call-backs, return calls, disconnections, and scheduling logistics without enough detail to judge satisfaction.

limitations: Most sampled fragments are administrative call-back or follow-up statements with unclear sentiment.
The cluster mixes service communication logistics with emergency call system malfunction reports, so it is not a single coherent issue.
Only a small number of examples show explicit sentiment, which limits detail on customer evaluation.
